description: Java class implementing a command response sender for AMQP communication in the Eclipse Hono project, handling message sending, span management, and sender creation.

classes.name: CommandResponseSenderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CommandResponseSender for sending command responses over AMQP, managing message creation, span context, and sender lifecycle.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome, wrapping sendMessageAndWaitForOutcome.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no specific 'to' address.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint string for command responses.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the delivery outcome.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Overloaded method to send a message with a specific span context.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs target address string based on tenantId and replyId.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Converts CommandResponse to message, sets address, and sends, returning a Future of delivery.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new CommandResponseSender with configured flow latency, returning a Future.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a new tracing span for forwarding command response.
